extraction.name: AI2 Reasoning Challenge (ARC)
extraction.description: A dataset of 7,787 natural, grade-school science questions partitioned into a Challenge Set and an Easy Set, along with a corpus of 14M science sentences.
extraction.creator: Peter Clark, Isaac Cowhey, Oren Etzioni, Tushar Khot, Ashish Sabharwal, Carissa Schoenick, Oyvind Tafjord
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Questions were obtained through extensive search and investigation of standardized tests. The text corpus was created by running search queries on a major search engine using hand-written templates for science topics.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Natural science questions authored for use on standardized tests, and a corpus of science-related sentences mined from the Web.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: For the ARC Corpus, documents from search queries were collected, de-duplicated, stripped down to capture just the text, and then chunked into sentences. The corpus was then augmented with the AristoMini corpus.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Documents were collected, de-duplicated, stripped down to capture just the text, and chunked into sentences. Questions were partitioned into a Challenge Set and an Easy Set using IR and PMI solvers.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The underlying IR methods have a retrieval bias towards sentences that are very similar to the question, and away from sentences that individually only partially match the question.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Dev, and Testing for advanced question answering.
